The '''CP-9 Nanoshield Probe''' was a model of small [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] used by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Maki'voro]], a lieutenant of the spymaster known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]]. One of a number of probe models that Maki'voro used, the CP-9 probe was designed to shield Maki'voro and rapidly heal him.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
CP-9 Nanoshield Probes appear as enemies in the missions "Dark Design" and "All the Pieces," which are the Republic and Imperial versions of a mission in the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] mission in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
